scientific_integrity: Explicit Fourier-fiber proof for all group orders; independent audit not performed and publication priority not certified.
scientific_limitations: Only supports of three distinct elements with each coefficient one.
Ranks and nullities are over complex scalars.
No claims for larger support, unequal weights, or noncyclic index-two abelian kernels.
Modular finite tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.
An implicit earlier equivalent of the arithmetic census is a residual historical risk.
title: Arithmetic nullity and exact three-tap support census on dicyclic groups
